extraction.disclaimer_span: We do not offer every plan available in your area. Currently we represent 26 organizations which offer 3,740 products in your area. Please contact Medicare.gov or 1-800-MEDICARE to get information on all of your options.
extraction.benefits_span: The Humana plan available in Orange County has a $25 monthly premium, a $305 drug deductible and a $5300 maximum out-of-pocket.
extraction.soa_span: I've sent the Scope of Appointment to your email so we can go over specific plans. Can you sign it while we're on the line?

composition.summary: The agent discussed plan benefits before the disclaimer, which is non-compliant. The agent also scheduled a plan review appointment 6 hours after sending the Scope of Appointment, which is compliant.
composition.coaching_note: Grace should ensure the disclaimer is read before discussing plan benefits. Additionally, she should schedule the appointment closer to the time of the call to avoid long wait times.
